items.title: Aggies Drop Home Contest to Jax State
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State returned home for its final Weekday CUSA contest of the 2026 season, falling 24-0 to Jax State on Wednesday at Aggie Memorial Stadium. NM State came away with a pair of interceptions, however, a pair of missed field goals and turnovers hurt the Aggies in the Conference USA matchup.

items.title: NM State Welcomes Jax State in Final Weekday CUSA Contest
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State Football is slated to return to Aggie Memorial Stadium on Wednesday night as it hosts Jax State in what will serve as the Aggies' final Weekday CUSA game of the season. The battle features a pair of teams near the top of the league standings as NM State holds a 2-1 record and Jax State enters with a 3-0 mark in conference play ahead of Wednesday. items.title: NM State Outlasts Sam Houston in Wednesday Night Win
items.summary: HUNTSVILLE, Texas – Playing in their fourth consecutive contest in front of a nationally televised audience, NM State took to the road for a battle with Sam Houston. items.title: Aggies Continue Conference USA Play at Sam Houston on Wednesday
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – After a week away, the Aggies will return to action on Wednesday night as they travel to Huntsville, Texas, to square off with Sam Houston at Elliott T. Bowers Stadium. This will mark the fourth all-time meeting between the Aggies and Bearkats and will serve as NM State's second trip ever to Huntsville. Kickoff for the Weekday CUSA bout is slated for 6 p.m.

items.title: Aggies Drop Weekday Clash in Miami
items.summary: MIAMI – Playing in its second midweek game of the season, NM State returned to action on Wednesday night, taking on the FIU Panthers as part of Weekday CUSA. Behind a trio of giveaways, the Aggies recorded their lowest scoring output of the season, falling 22-3. With the loss, NM State falls to 2-4 on the season, with a 1-1 mark in Conference USA action. items.title: Aggies Set to Face Off with FIU on Wednesday Night
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – Following a pair of home games, NM State returns to the road once again as they make the trip to South Florida to take on FIU in a Wednesday Conference USA matchup. This will mark the fourth time that the Aggies are on national television this season as the bout is slated to air on ESPN2 at 5:30 p.m. MDT.

items.title: James Jones Earns Conference USA Offensive Player of the Week Honors
items.summary: DALLAS – After yet another impressive performance this past Thursday, Aggie running back James Jones has been named the Conference USA Offensive Player of the Week for Week 5 based on a vote of media members from throughout the league.

items.title: Aggies Shine in All Three Phases to Defeat Western Kentucky in CUSA Opener
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State put together a complete team victory as it earned a commanding 34-13 win over Western Kentucky on Thursday night at Aggie Memorial Stadium. The Aggies were fueled by 155 rushing yards from James Jones in addition to a six-sack performance from the NM State defense.

items.title: Know Before You Go: Week 5 vs. Western Kentucky
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – As part of the gameday experience, NM State Athletics will produce a weekly Know Before You Go featuring information to ensure all fans have a great experience when visiting Aggie Memorial Stadium.

items.title: Aggies Open Conference USA Action on Thursday Against WKU
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State will be back at Aggie Memorial Stadium on Thursday night as it hosts Western Kentucky to open a stretch of four consecutive midweek Conference USA contests. This will also serve as the second of five straight nationally televised games for the Aggies.
